dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Do you have something more recent to say?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Huh... Looks like this batch isn't good enough for you.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Well, how about this, then? Did you know? The ancient god who rules over Liyue lost his life in an unfortunate incident during the annual Rite of Descension!

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: It all happened so suddenly, and the Rite of Descension suddenly turned into the Rite of Parting. Was it a natural disaster? Or some kind of plot?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Would you like to know more? Well, if you're curious, then you've gotta show your appreciation for such detailed intel, you know?
